# Requirements

## Requirement 1: Production startup

### Acceptance Criteria

1. The site metadata rule count equals the real registered checker count without bundling TypeScript, Vite or Rolldown into the metadata consumer.
2. The built site starts under Node and returns correct health, manifest, home, documentation and not-found responses. Failure to start or answer requests fails qualification.
